title: MV How to use MOG's animated text plugin

posts.author: AshUnderdash
posts.body:
Hello!! Sorry if this is a somewhat simple question, I'm very new to plugins.
I bought a plugin pack that contains Moghunter's "AnimatedText" plugin (
seen in this video but for MV
) but the instructions seem to by in Spanish and google translate isn't helping much AND the original wordpress for it has been deleted. posts.author: ISC
posts.body:
ID:
Just like with images, you need to assign a unique number here.
MODE:
This is a number from 0 to 9 and determines the text effect, such as rotation, bounce, etc. You can find the full list in the plugin description.
X:
As with images, this is the x-position for the text.
Y:
As with images, this is the y-position for the text.
FONTSIZE:
Font size. If I remember correctly, the default size in RPG Maker MV is 26.
DURATION:
Similar to moving images, this is the animation's duration in frames.
SPEED:
The speed at which the text disappears. It may seem the same as the duration, but it’s actually different. If the speed is too high, it can cut off the animation.
COLOR:
The same numbers you use for text colors in the message box.
ALIGN:
Left, right, center. Refer to the plugin description for the respective reference numbers.
TEXT:
Whatever you want to write.
Important note: With a bit of practice, you'll be able to combine multiple effects to create more complex and artistic animations.
